mails.subject: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Hi Alex,

We'd like to move our operations team to Fernway in Q4. Could you send a quote for the Business plan, 40 seats, annual, starting {{d:+15}}?

Thanks,
Jane Lee
Head of Operations, Northwind

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Hi Jane,

Great to hear. I'll send the quote this week. One question first: do you need SSO for the team?

Best,
Alex

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Yes, SSO is a must. We'd also like onboarding help for the team leads.

Jane

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Hi Jane,

Here is the quote: Business plan, 40 seats at $20 per seat per month, billed annually, $9,600 per year. SSO and guided onboarding are included. The quote is valid for 30 days, until {{d:-7}}.

Best,
Alex

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Thanks Alex. I'm reviewing it with finance and will come back by {{d:-16}}.

Jane

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Hi Alex, finance asked whether we could pay quarterly instead of annually up front. Is that possible?

Jane

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Hi Jane,

Yes. Quarterly invoicing is available on annual plans with a 3% surcharge. Annual up front stays at $9,600.

Best,
Alex

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Thanks, finance is fine with annual up front. We'll come back on the final number soon.

Jane

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Sounds good, Jane. I'll keep the quoted price open for you until it expires on {{d:-7}}.

Best,
Alex

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Quick heads-up: procurement wants to see if there is any room on price before sign-off. I'll send specifics shortly.

Jane

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Thanks for the heads-up, Jane. Send them over whenever you're ready.

Alex

mails.subject: Re: Q4 quote for Fernway Business
mails.body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for the proposal. We can sign by {{d:+7}} if the annual plan comes down 10%, so the team can start on {{d:+15}}. Could you also confirm onboarding is included, and send the updated quote as a PDF?

Thanks,
Jane
